title: TemporalMemorySpikeChallenge
description: Family payload for temporal-memory-spike-challenges. Specified oracle: a validated recurrent SNN implementation. No such runtime is bound in this repository, so the recurrent delay-loop network in pipelines/oracle_grounded/sim.py runs instead and the record is stamped implementation: 'reference'. The generator proposes a delayed-dependency trial: a cue, a delay, distractors, and optionally a reset; the oracle runs the trial and reports which output the network selects at the probe. Temporal dependence is measured, not assumed: the same network is re-run with the cue removed (and, when present, with the reset removed), and a record is accepted only if that changes the measured response. Trials where the loop forgot before the probe are kept as rejected records with that reason, because a forgotten cue is a real measurement of the retention limit.

delay_ms.description: probe_ms - cue_ms; the interval the network must bridge.

distractor_ms.description: Times of distractor pulses inside the delay.

reset_ms.description: Time of a state-reset pulse, or null. A reset drives both latches below the point where the next delayed loop spike can re-fire them.

event_sparsity.description: Events per 100 ms of delay; lower means sparser.

network_variant.description: Loop parameters the generator varies. latch_adaptation_b sets how fast the loop fatigues and therefore how long the state survives.

intervention.description: The delay structure in the scenario is the manipulation; the ablations are oracle-side controls.

probes.description: Control re-runs of the same network. cue_ablation is always present.

demonstrated.description: True only when removing an earlier event changed the measured response. Accepted records must have this true.

distractor_invariant.description: Whether displacing the distractors left the response unchanged; null when the trial had none.

response.description: Derived from OA/OB spikes inside the response window: only OA means A, only OB means B, neither or both means none.

response_ambiguous.description: True when both readouts fired inside the response window; the network did not resolve the choice and the record is rejected.

latch_last_spike_ms.description: Latest latch spike at or before the probe, so state_retained_at_probe is derivable.

state_retained_at_probe.description: Whether a memory loop spiked within 1.5 loop periods before the probe.
